requirement: Section 28: Fresh audit must explicitly inspect for the 15 named anti-patterns below. Any blocker prevents Phase 3 closure.

findings.evidence: The sole production change (completeness-check.ts's recursive walk() descent) operates on the generic IRUnsupportedExpression.attemptedStructure sidecar shared by ALL calculation expressions (definitions AND rule capacityExpressions alike) - it is not gated on any definition-specific type or field. The 12-region reality check exercised it identically across DEBT/LIENS/RESTRICTED_PAYMENTS/ASSET_SALES/FINANCIAL_COVENANT/REPORTING/CROSS_REFERENCE families, not only DEFINITIONS.

grep -rniE 'consolidated ebitda|consolidated net income' lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/*.ts finds 3 hits, all in prompt.ts's generic few-shot illustration (metricName examples like 'Consolidated EBITDA' or 'Consolidated Total Assets', and one worked §9.01(c) example unrelated to Superior's real §1.01 EBITDA definition) - these are illustrative, not EBITDA-specific behavioral instructions, and were already reviewed/accepted in a prior mission. No new prompt.ts change was made this mission.

grep -rn 'Superior' lib/contract-model/ (excluding tests) finds exactly 1 hit: a code COMMENT in relationship-resolution.ts noting a regex was 'confirmed by live reproduction against Superior' - disclosing validation provenance, not conditioning any behavior on the string 'Superior' or any Superior-specific value.
No new lookup table, enum, or switch keyed on covenant family/provision name was added this mission. The one production change is family-agnostic tree recursion.
No dollar amount, percentage, or ratio from the Superior holdout GT (or from any known package) was hardcoded into production code this mission.
grep for A1/B1/B2/B3/B4 claim-ID markers or specific clause counts (19, 20) in lib/contract-model/compiler/semantic/*.ts returns no matches.
The wire schema (wire-schema.ts) remains tolerant-string-typed as established in Phase 3B; this mission made no schema changes.
No separate Pass-A semantic-inventory stage exists (03-decomposition-architecture-decision.json); there is no inventory to silently omit from.

The reality check found 36 real MATERIAL findings across 12 regions (14-whole-agreement-reality-check-results.json) - genuine composition gaps exist, but every one was surfaced by the independent verifier with a citation, never silently dropped.

14-whole-agreement-reality-check-results.json's own overallGateAssessment explicitly states materialRecallGreaterThan95Percent: NOT MET, rather than rounding up or omitting the unfavorable figure. 16-agreement-level-coverage.json's worked rollup example correctly resolves to SEMANTICALLY_INCOMPLETE rather than a false COMPLETE.

No region across the holdout replay or reality check reported a status implying financial computability (e.g. a clean VERIFIED with a fully wired capacityExpression) that the underlying source did not support; all 12 reality-check regions and 6 of 8 holdout regions correctly returned REVIEW_REQUIRED/PARTIAL compile status.

The independent verifier (a separate module from the compiler, per the 3C Independence Contract) was not touched this mission. semanticReviewInvoked=true fired in all 20 real compile+verify calls this mission (8 holdout + 12 reality-check), and MATERIAL_DISCREPANCY/VERIFICATION_INCOMPLETE was the outcome in all 20 - the verifier caught real gaps at its historical rate, not a reduced one.

15-dependency-graph-check.json demonstrates real RULE->DEFINITION and RULE->RULE dependency wiring on 3 real provisions (exceeding the Section 23 minimum), but also discloses that the region purpose-built to test cross-covenant/shared-cap dependency wiring (cross-reference-dsgr) produced none, and no region produced a populated SharedCapacity object despite a confirmed real shared cap existing in the source text. This is a genuine, specific limitation, not lost coverage that was hidden - it is documented as the leading concrete gap for continuation.

Every rule, definition, and verifier finding examined across both the holdout replay and reality check carries a real sourceCitation/sourceEvidence/excerpt field tied to the actual DSGR/LSB/Superior text - spot-checked across debt-dsgr, restricted-payments-dsgr, and liens-dsgr-a in this audit.

This mission does not claim whole-agreement coverage. 14's own honest conclusion states recall is 'NOT close to the mission's own >=95% target' on real unseen content, and 16's rollup concept demonstrates a conservative, non-overclaiming aggregate status by design.

auditConclusion: No architectural anti-pattern from Section 28's list constitutes a blocker to reporting results honestly. One genuine, disclosed limitation (shared-cap/cross-reference dependency wiring) is real and material but does not itself indicate benchmark gaming, overclaiming, or safety erosion - it is exactly the kind of finding this mission's own reality check was designed to surface.
